description: The HydroMT-wflow project deposits three public tar.gz files for model building and testing: example wflow models, an approximately 71 MB artifact-data package and a smaller build-data package. Zenodo labels the record CC BY 4.0 and says version 0.1.1 added unit-build data, legacy artifact inputs with demand, a merit_utm item and wflow example models. For a hydrological simulation, these fixtures could test model setup and compare generated inputs with a documented reference. They are examples and test resources, not a validated river-flow series for every basin. The page warns that individual component licences should be checked in YAML or with original data providers, so the aggregate Zenodo rights label does not guarantee all input reuse. The related catalogue wflow record covers the general model; this deposit has a separate test-data address. No archive was downloaded, and basin locations, files, units and expected model outputs remain unchecked.
name: hydromt-wflow-data
notes: G6 item G6-2300. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
